ayahs.1: Qasam hai chaasht ke waqt ki.
ayahs.2: Aur qasam hai raat ki jab chha jaaye.
ayahs.3: Na to tere Rabb ne tujhe chhoda hai aur na woh bezaar hua hai.
ayahs.4: Yaqeenan tere liye anjaam aaghaaz se behtar hoga.
ayahs.5: Tujhe tera Rabb bahut jald (inaam) dega aur tu raazi (wa khush) ho jaayega.
ayahs.6: Kya us ne tujhe yateem pa kar jagah nahin di.
ayahs.7: Aur tujhe raah-bhoola pa kar hidayat nahin di.
ayahs.8: Aur tujhe naadaar pa kar tawangar nahin bana diya?
ayahs.9: Pas yateem par tu bhi sakhti na kiya kar.
ayahs.10: Aur na sawaal karne wale ko daant-dapat.
ayahs.11: Aur apne Rabb ki naimaton ko bayan karta reh.
